scenario.description: No scenario file: the sim adapter records the commands the planner sent and nothing else. No virtual chip, no sensors and no injected faults, so there is no reality to configure - and nothing was measured, which is why simulated_hardware is true.

events.narration: Load the cells (expanded off-chip) into the seeding chamber: feed m1_ipsc_in_1 (selector valve on cells), vent m1_out_1, lane inlets capped.
The cells flow through the split into the three culture chambers; the three lanes open through m1_out_1, which is vented, while the lane inlets stay capped.

Differentiate. Once a day (placeholder) one chamber volume of each lane's own medium and factor is fed through its lane inlet (off-chip selector valve on medium plus factor), drains through m1_out_1, then flow stops. m1_ipsc_in_1 is capped. 14 days (placeholder).
Label each chamber with its own label (each lane inlet's selector valve set to its label), so cells from different chambers can be pooled later and still told apart.

Collect supernatant from m1_astrocyte_1 (before): feed only m1_factor_2 and vent m1_out_1, with the other lane inlets capped, so only this lane's liquid reaches the one outlet.
Collect supernatant from m1_microglia_1 (before): feed only m1_factor_3 and vent m1_out_1, with the other lane inlets capped, so only this lane's liquid reaches the one outlet.

Interaction period, 3 days (placeholder), interaction chip: only m1_factor_1 is fed and m1_factor_2 and m1_factor_3 are vented, with m1_out_1 capped. Conditioned medium crosses the shared outlet junction so the cell types signal to each other.
